b5.zh_the_drake_armies_join_below_the_hi.rumor: Travellers say two Drake armies have joined in the hills below the High Pass to hunt the Goblin Lord.

canon_ref.note: The chapter's own 'Day 59' is game day 103 (a guess: Venitra still spoke of two armies on day 102). Days 59-67 are 103-111.

b5.zh_the_drake_armies_join_below_the_hi.summary: Below the High Pass, General Thrissiam's army from Pallass joins General Garusa's from the Trisstral Alliance: over 20,000 soldiers. Garusa hands him command, but Zel warned her about this Goblin Lord.

b5.zi_the_goblin_lord_ambushes_the_drake.rumor: Runners say the Drake armies are fighting Goblins and the walking dead in the hills below the High Pass.

canon_ref.note: Day 106 is 'Day 62'. On 'Day 64' [Message] spells are blocked and Garusa saves Osthia from a rash charge.

b5.zi_the_goblin_lord_ambushes_the_drake.summary: For days the Drake scouts vanish. Then Goblins and undead burst from under the snow, and grey Goblins explode among the ranks. Osthia sees the Goblin Lord kill a Drake [Mage].

b5.zj_the_drake_armies_are_destroyed.rumor: No word has come from the Drake armies below the High Pass for days. [Message] spells find no one.

canon_ref.note: 'Day 66'. The Necromancer is named Az'kerash later (4.26 M). The Goblin army loots the camp and goes north. Liscor hears only in 4.24 (a dying scout).

b5.zj_the_drake_armies_are_destroyed.summary: Garusa reaches the Goblin Lord, but the Necromancer speaks through him and kills her. A black scythe cuts the lines and the dead rise. Thrissiam sends Runners south, falls and rises undead; Osthia is caught.

canon_ref.note: 'Day 67'. The Goblin Lord is unnamed (no NPC id). He calls the Necromancer their shared enemy.

b5.zk_osthia_speaks_with_the_goblin_lord.summary: Osthia wakes in chains in her uncle's tent. She hears the Necromancer scold the Goblin Lord through his own mouth. The Goblin Lord shows her a Goblin child his master raised, and asks her about the Necromancer.
